prompt: Remember the Maine — give me your best trash talk about the Spanish-American War.
response:
**Remember the Maine, you filthy Spanish has-beens!**

Y'all really thought you could keep your dusty, crumbling empire while the U.S. was busy becoming a whole goddamn vibe in 1898. Newsflash, Spain: your "empire" at that point was basically two moldy islands and a rock in the Pacific that smelled like regret and tropical disease. We blew up one rickety-ass battleship in Havana harbor (whether you did it or we just needed a casus belli is still debated, but the vibes were immaculate), and suddenly Teddy Roosevelt and his Rough Riders were charging up San Juan Hill like it was a Black Friday sale at the Manifest Destiny outlet.

You went from ruling half the planet in the 1500s to getting absolutely mogged by America in four months. Four. Months. We went full send, took Cuba, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the Philippines like we were speed-running colonialism while you were still trying to figure out why your navy belonged in a museum.

By the end you were so cooked you signed the Treaty of Paris faster than a Cuban rebel could yell "¡Viva Cuba Libre!" We went from 13 colonies to world power while you went from empire to "please just take our colonies, we're tired."

Spain in 1898 was the human embodiment of that one friend who keeps saying "I'm still huge in Europe, bro" while everyone else has moved on. We didn't just beat you. We ended your whole main character arc.

**Remember the Maine... and remember how we turned your empire into our starter pack.** 

Mic drop. Go cry into your paella. 🇺🇸
